description: Displays validation and generation issues for a modeling document. MO1 places it as the collapsible dock under the preview: the header carries the neutral count-only badge and the collapse toggle (aria-expanded + aria-controls); a collapsed panel renders the header only. The dock height belongs to the host's grid row (the panel's own min/max-height pair is gone), and the two-way Collapsed state is the session's. Fáze 11 adds an opt-in filter bar (ShowFilterBar): severity chips with counts (native aria-pressed toggle buttons), an accent-insensitive text search over message/category/source and a sort select (ModelingIssueSortMode Input | Severity | Source) — the rendered rows are a memoized projection; the Issues collection is never mutated. Root attributes carry data-visible-issue-count and data-total-issue-count (data-issue-count keeps reporting the total).

parameters.name: Issues
parameters.description: The issues to present. The panel renders a filtered/sorted PROJECTION of this list and never mutates it; severity only colors the rows. With SortMode = Input (the default) the rows follow the input order. Issues without a SourceElementId/SourceRelationshipId render as non-interactive list items; navigable issues render as buttons. Row test ids carry the ORIGINAL input index, so filtering/sorting never renumbers rows.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the panel root.

parameters.name: OnIssueSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects an issue that points to a model element or relationship.

parameters.name: Collapsed
parameters.description: Whether the panel body (the issue list or the empty state) is collapsed to the header. Two-way bindable - the host owns the dock height around the collapsed/expanded row. Default false (expanded); the state is the session's and survives re-renders. A collapsed dock hides the filter bar too (the bar lives inside the body).

parameters.name: CollapsedChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user toggles the panel through the header button; enables @bind-Collapsed.

parameters.name: ShowToggle
parameters.description: Whether the header renders the collapse toggle. Default true (the docked dock). The mobile Issues tab passes false: the tab body is the whole scroll surface, so the header stays a plain heading.

parameters.name: ShowFilterBar
parameters.description: Whether the filter bar (severity chips with counts, text search, sort select) renders above the list. Default false - the pre-Fáze 11 presentation; the hosting editor passes true on every band (desktop dock, tablet sheet, mobile tab). The bar renders only when Issues is not empty and hides with the collapsed body.

parameters.name: SeverityFilter
parameters.description: Optional two-way binding of the active severity filter; null (or empty) means every severity. The parameter SEEDS the internal filter whenever the host hands over a new collection and is never assigned inside the component - the hosting editor owns the state so it survives dock collapse and panel remounts.

parameters.name: SeverityFilterChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user toggles a severity chip (or clears the filters); enables @bind-SeverityFilter. An empty active set is reported as null.

parameters.name: FilterText
parameters.description: Optional two-way binding of the text filter. The parameter SEEDS the internal filter whenever the host hands over a new value and is never assigned inside the component - the same seed/echo pattern as TmModelingModelTree.FilterText (including echo recording, so a host RESET to the current value re-seeds). Matches message, category and source element/relationship name case- and accent-insensitively.

parameters.name: FilterTextChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user edits the filter input (not when the host re-seeds the parameter), enabling @bind-FilterText.

parameters.name: SortMode
parameters.description: Sort mode of the rendered rows; Input (the default) never re-sorts. Severity orders Error > Warning > Info, stable within a group; Source orders by the resolved source display name with sourceless issues last. The host owns the state through SortModeChanged.

parameters.name: SortModeChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user picks a sort mode; enables @bind-SortMode.

parameters.name: Elements
parameters.description: Optional element list of the loaded model - the source of display NAMES for the text search and the Source sort. Without it those features fall back to the raw source ids.

parameters.name: Relationships
parameters.description: Optional relationship list - the source of relationship names (as Elements).

parameters.name: ContentVersion
parameters.description: Host-owned content version of the element/relationship tables. The editor mutates the DTOs in place (an inspector rename), so the render gate and the visible-issues memo key on this counter too - bump it whenever the names behind Elements/Relationships change without replacing the collections.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__toggle
cssClasses.description: The header collapse toggle - an icon-only native button at the coarse-pointer target with aria-expanded/aria-controls and a state-aware sr-only label.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__content
cssClasses.description: The collapsible body wrapper (the list or the empty state); min-height 0 keeps the parent-owned row contract.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__count
cssClasses.description: Count-only badge in the header: visible text is the bare count, the localized formulation is the aria-label.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__severity
cssClasses.description: Severity label in the row meta, tinted with the severity text token (`--severity--{info|warning|error}`).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__fix
cssClasses.description: Suggested-fix toned box (primary subtle tokens) holding the icon, the localized prefix label and the fix text.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__chevron
cssClasses.description: Navigation chevron rendered only inside navigable issue buttons (TmIcon ChevronRight), aria-hidden.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__filterbar
cssClasses.description: The wrapping filter row above the list (severity chips, search input, sort select); hides with the collapsed body.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__chip
cssClasses.description: A severity filter chip - a native toggle button carrying aria-pressed and the per-severity count.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__filter-input
cssClasses.description: The TmSearchInput wrapper for the accent-insensitive text filter.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__filter-sort
cssClasses.description: The TmSelect wrapper for the sort mode (visible localized label).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__empty--no-match
cssClasses.description: The no-match state shown when the active filters hide every row, with the clear-filters action.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__clear
cssClasses.description: The clear-filters button inside the no-match state.
